reasoning_content:
Clean state: All development server ports are closed, all 10 containers are up, free memory 1.1GB. Next, final clean procedure:
1. Set fixed ports in ports.json (39001/39002/39003 — all free)
2. `just up --detach --no-seed` to render nginx.conf matching them
3. A single `just serve` (all 3) — all builds are cached now

Since all 3 builds are cached, the startup should be fast and memory usage should also be low. The OOM risk is now much lower (cached builds have smaller peak memory than cold builds). Alright, let's execute.

action.command:
cd /workspace
cat > .urbo/workspace/ports.json <<'EOF'
{
  "app": 39001,
  "cms": 39002,
  "boards": 39003
}
EOF
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
timeout 300 just up --detach --no-seed > /tmp/final-render.log 2>&1; echo "render exit=$?"
echo "=== nginx upstreams ==="; grep -oE "172\.[0-9.]+:[0-9]+" .urbo/workspace/nginx.conf | sort -u
echo "=== ports.json ==="; cat .urbo/workspace/ports.json
